g.text: DocLayNet layout models — accuracy vs. inference time

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #444444

g.text: All 39 YOLO checkpoints are DocLayNet fine-tunes (11 classes), verified via model.names. Points use the latest successful OmniDocBench layout CSV per model/device; the side labels list every model and both times. docling_heron_101 is CPU-only in this benchmark; no GPU result is plotted.
